policies.issuer_zh: 国家数据局、国家发展改革委、工业和信息化部等
policies.issuer_en: National Data Bureau, NDRC, MIIT, et al.

detail.direction_zh: 国家数据局牵头、17部门联合，把数据作为生产要素系统性激活，覆盖工业制造、现代农业、商贸流通、交通运输、金融、科技创新、文旅、医疗健康等12个重点领域；强调高质量数据供给与合规高效流通，到2026年底打造300个以上典型应用场景、数据产业年均增速超20%、数据交易规模倍增。
detail.direction_en: Led by the National Data Administration with 17 departments, the plan systematically activates data as a production factor across 12 priority sectors (industrial manufacturing first among them), pushing high-quality data supply and compliant, efficient circulation. By end-2026: 300+ benchmark application scenarios, >20% annual growth in the data industry, and a doubling of data-trading scale.

initiatives.zh: 工业制造列为12个重点领域之首，以数据放大、叠加、倍增效应提升制造业竞争力与效率
initiatives.en: Industrial manufacturing named first of 12 priority sectors, leveraging the amplifying/superimposing/multiplying effects of data to lift manufacturing competitiveness

initiatives.zh: 需求场景牵引，强化数据安全保障，建设跨领域互联互通的数据环境
initiatives.en: Demand-/scenario-driven adoption, strengthened data-security safeguards, and cross-domain interconnected data environments

initiatives.zh: 培育一批优质数据商和第三方专业服务机构
initiatives.en: Cultivate a cohort of quality data vendors and third-party professional service institutions

detail.focus_zh: 高质量数据供给、合规高效流通、跨行业数据互联互通；以应用场景倍增放大数据要素价值
detail.focus_en: High-quality data supply, compliant/efficient circulation, cross-industry data interoperability; multiplying value through application scenarios
detail.implications_zh: 对工业软件意味着工业数据集与数据互操作性被提升为国家级要素工程：MES/工业互联网平台、PLM/CAD/CAE 产生的设计与制造数据获得流通与确权的政策通道，利好工业数据中台、数据建模与工业APP；但要求软件在数据格式标准化、接口互联互通与数据安全合规上对齐国家要素流通框架。
detail.implications_en: For industrial software, industrial datasets and data interoperability are elevated to national factor-engineering: design/manufacturing data from MES, IIoT platforms, and PLM/CAD/CAE gain policy channels for circulation and rights confirmation—favoring industrial data middle-platforms, data modeling, and industrial apps. It also pressures software to standardize data formats, harden interface interoperability, and meet data-security compliance.

detail.direction_zh: 在「大规模设备更新」框架下，工业操作系统与工控软件被列为重点更新对象，DCS/PLC/SCADA 等成熟工控产品由「鼓励试点」转向「批量更新+国产替代」并行推进。
detail.direction_en: Under the large-scale equipment-update push, industrial operating systems and industrial-control software are designated priority renewal targets; mature control products (DCS/PLC/SCADA) shift from pilot encouragement toward batch renewal coupled with domestic substitution.

initiatives.zh: 工信部等七部门联合印发《推动工业领域设备更新实施方案》（工信部联规〔2024〕53号）

initiatives.zh: 到 2027 年工业领域设备投资规模较 2023 年增长 25% 以上；规上工业企业数字化研发设计工具普及率超 90%、关键工序数控化率超 75%

initiatives.zh: 据公开解读，到 2027 年计划更新约 200 万套工业软件、约 80 万套工业操作系统（PLC/DCS/SCADA 等），覆盖石化、航空、船舶等关键行业
initiatives.en: Per public readouts, plan targets renewing ~2M sets of industrial software and ~800k industrial OS sets (PLC/DCS/SCADA), covering petrochemical, aviation, shipbuilding and other key sectors

detail.focus_zh: 工业母机、工业软件（CAD/CAE/MES）及工业操作系统（PLC/DCS/SCADA/SIS/嵌入式）的迭代升级与国产化替代
detail.focus_en: Iterative upgrade and localization of machine tools, industrial software (CAD/CAE/MES) and industrial operating systems (PLC/DCS/SCADA/SIS/embedded)
detail.implications_zh: 把工控软件/DCS/PLC 明确写入设备更新清单，形成最直接的需求侧拉动：存量替换周期被政策压缩，国产 DCS/PLC/MES 厂商获得规模化进场窗口，工业软件不再仅靠单点采购而是随产线改造批量更新。
detail.implications_en: Naming control software/DCS/PLC in the renewal list creates the most direct demand-side pull: the replacement cycle for the installed base is compressed by policy, giving domestic DCS/PLC/MES vendors a scale entry window, and industrial software is procured in batches alongside production-line retrofits rather than one-off.

detail.direction_zh: 中国信息安全测评中心发布《安全可靠测评结果公告（2025年第1号）》，首次有一批国产 CPU 跨入最高的 Ⅱ 级——按测评口径 Ⅰ 级为「国内设计+海外代工」，Ⅱ 级为「设计到流片全流程自主」。标志国产算力底座从「可用」转向「全栈自主可控」。
detail.direction_en: CITSEC's 2025 Announcement No.1 placed a cohort of domestic CPUs at the top Grade Ⅱ. Under the scheme, Grade Ⅰ = domestic-design + overseas foundry, Grade Ⅱ = fully autonomous design-to-fab. It marks the domestic compute base moving from 'usable' to 'full-stack self-controllable'.

initiatives.zh: Ⅱ 级 CPU：飞腾腾云 S5000C-E、龙芯 3B6000、龙芯 3C6000、申威威鑫 H8000、麒麟 X90（海思）
initiatives.en: Grade Ⅱ CPUs: Phytium Tengyun S5000C-E, Loongson 3B6000, Loongson 3C6000, Sunway Weixin H8000, Kirin X90 (HiSilicon)

initiatives.zh: Ⅰ 级 CPU：申威 WY831（GC 版）、兆芯 KX-U6980S、兆芯 KX-6940S
initiatives.en: Grade Ⅰ CPUs: Sunway WY831 (GC), Zhaoxin KX-U6980S, Zhaoxin KX-6940S

initiatives.zh: 覆盖飞腾/ARM、龙芯/LoongArch、申威/SW、海思/ARM、兆芯/x86 五大国产指令集路线；测评有效期 3 年
initiatives.en: Spans five domestic ISA routes (Phytium/ARM, Loongson/LoongArch, Sunway, HiSilicon/ARM, Zhaoxin/x86); 3-year validity

detail.focus_zh: 覆盖五大国产指令集路线，以全流程自主作为 Ⅱ 级硬门槛
detail.focus_en: Spans the five domestic ISA routes, with full-process autonomy as the hard Grade-Ⅱ bar
detail.implications_zh: 工业软件（CAD/CAE/EDA）若要跑在完全国产栈上，CPU 是第一块基石。Ⅱ 级 CPU 出现意味着 CAE 大规模数值求解、EDA 仿真等高算力负载终于有了「无海外代工依赖」的承载平台；但多指令集并存也意味着工业软件需做多架构移植与编译优化，单一 x86 二进制不再适用。
detail.implications_en: For CAD/CAE/EDA on a fully domestic stack, the CPU is the foundational layer. Grade Ⅱ CPUs mean heavy numerical solvers (CAE) and EDA simulation finally have a host platform free of overseas-foundry dependence; but the coexistence of multiple ISAs forces industrial software into multi-arch porting and compiler tuning—single x86 binaries no longer suffice.

Though a voluntary group standard, it is often cited by tender owners as a bonus or threshold criterion, so vendors should gap-analyze against its indicators and submit for evaluation early.

policies.actual_note_zh: 国办发〔2025〕34号，2026-01-01施行；组件成本占比分产品过渡期3–5年
policies.actual_note_en: Guoban [2025] No.34 effective 2026-01-01; component-cost ratios phased 3–5 years
policies.summary_zh: 构建政府采购本国产品标准与价格支持政策
policies.summary_en: Domestic product standards and price support in government procurement

detail.direction_zh: 首次确立统一的政府采购「本国产品」价格评审优惠机制：本国产品在评审时按报价给予 20% 价格扣除，以扣除后价格参与竞争，把价格杠杆制度化。
detail.direction_en: Establishes for the first time a unified price-evaluation preference for domestic products in government procurement: domestic products receive a 20% deduction on their quoted price for evaluation purposes, institutionalizing the price lever.

initiatives.zh: 国务院办公厅《关于在政府采购中实施本国产品标准及相关政策的通知》（国办发〔2025〕34号），财政部牵头
initiatives.en: State Council General Office Notice on Implementing Domestic-Product Standards in Government Procurement (Guoban Fa [2025] No.34), led by the MOF

initiatives.zh: 竞争中既有本国产品又有非本国产品时，对本国产品报价给予 20% 价格扣除，用扣除后价格参与评审
initiatives.en: When both domestic and non-domestic products compete, domestic-product quotes get a 20% deduction and the deducted price is used for evaluation

initiatives.zh: 含多种产品的采购包，若供应商所供符合本国产品标准的产品成本占其全部产品成本 80% 以上，则对全部产品总报价给予 20% 扣除
initiatives.en: For multi-product packages, if the supplier's domestic-qualifying product cost reaches >=80% of total, the 20% deduction applies to the entire bid

detail.focus_zh: 政府采购需求侧；价格评审优惠适用于符合「本国产品」标准的货物（含软件类产品）
detail.focus_en: Government-procurement demand side; the price-evaluation preference applies to goods (including software products) meeting the domestic-product standard
detail.implications_zh: 对工业软件/工控产品意味着稳定、可量化的政府需求侧补贴：国产 CAD/CAE/MES/PLC 在政采项目中获得 20% 的实质性价格缓冲，足以抵消与海外成熟产品的部分价差，降低采购方「选国产」的成本顾虑——从「鼓励国产」转向「制度化偏好国产」。
detail.implications_en: For industrial software/control products this means a stable, quantified demand-side subsidy: domestic CAD/CAE/MES/PLC gain a 20% effective price cushion in public procurement, enough to offset part of the gap with mature foreign products and lower buyers' cost concern—shifting from encouraging to institutionally preferring domestic.

policies.title_zh: 政府采购本国产品认定：境内生产组件成本占比门槛
policies.title_en: Domestic-product eligibility: in-China component cost ratio threshold
policies.summary_zh: 国办发〔2025〕34号配套：一般产品须达到境内生产组件成本占比要求方可享受本国产品政策
policies.summary_en: Guoban [2025] No.34配套: general products must meet in-China component-cost ratio to qualify as domestic products
policies.metric_zh: 一般产品境内生产组件成本占比
policies.metric_en: In-China component cost share for general products
policies.actual_note_zh: 部分产品类别设3–5年过渡期；具体目录产品比例以财政部会同有关部门发布的标准文本为准
policies.actual_note_en: Some categories have 3–5 year phase-in; product-specific ratios per MOF co-published standard text
policies.issuer_en: General Office of the State Council

detail.direction_zh: 为「本国产品」给出可执行的认定口径：以「境内生产组件成本占比」达到规定比例作为核心门槛，并要求供应商披露装配地、采购地、生产地等信息以核验本地化含量。
detail.direction_en: Provides an operable definition of a domestic product: the core criterion is that the cost share of components produced within China reaches a prescribed ratio, with suppliers required to disclose assembly, procurement and production locations to verify localization content.

initiatives.zh: 认定要件：产品在中国境内生产，且境内生产组件成本占比达到规定比例
initiatives.en: Qualification criterion: the product is produced in China and the cost share of domestically produced components reaches a prescribed ratio

initiatives.zh: 具体组件成本占比不一刀切：由财政部按不同行业，在出台采购需求标准后的 3 至 5 年内分行业确定/动态调整；门槛确立前满足其他条件的可先认定
initiatives.en: The specific component-cost ratio is not one-size-fits-all: the MOF sets/adjusts it by industry within 3-5 years after issuing procurement-requirement standards; before thresholds are set, products meeting other conditions may qualify

initiatives.zh: 含直接进口组件的产品，供应商须提供装配地点、采购地址、生产地点等信息以证明本地化含量
initiatives.en: For products containing directly imported components, suppliers must provide assembly/procurement/production-location information to substantiate localization content

detail.focus_zh: 本国产品认定的成本/组件口径，决定哪些工业软件与工控硬件能享受 20% 价格扣除
detail.focus_en: The cost/component basis for domestic-product qualification, determining which industrial software and control hardware can enjoy the 20% deduction
detail.implications_zh: 认定门槛把「形式上国产」与「实质上国产」区分开：纯壳套海外内核（如套用海外 CAD/EDA 几何/求解内核、或用进口 CPU/工控主板贴牌）可能因境内组件成本占比不足而难以达标，从而把政采红利导向自研内核、国产 CPU/工控芯片配套的工业软件栈，强化对底层（几何内核/求解器/芯片）国产化的拉动。
detail.implications_en: The threshold separates nominally-domestic from substantively-domestic products: shells wrapping foreign cores (e.g., reusing foreign CAD/EDA geometry/solver kernels, or rebadging imported CPUs/control boards) may fail the domestic-component cost share, steering procurement benefits toward stacks with self-developed kernels and domestic CPU/control-chip integration—reinforcing pull on the underlying layers (geometry kernel/solver/chip).

policies.title_zh: 「十五五」建议：全面实施「人工智能+」行动
policies.title_en: 15th FYP Proposal: full rollout of the "AI+" initiative
policies.summary_zh: 建议第六章部署数字中国建设，提出全面实施「人工智能+」、健全实数融合制度
policies.summary_en: Digital China chapter of the proposal mandates full "AI+" rollout and stronger digital–real economy integration
policies.metric_zh: 「人工智能+」行动覆盖范围
policies.actual_note_zh: 建议层面为战略部署；可量化分解指标见工信部等部委后续专项行动（如「人工智能+制造」）
policies.actual_note_en: Strategic mandate at proposal level; quantified breakdown appears in follow-on ministry actions (e.g. AI+Manufacturing)

detail.direction_zh: 十五五建议在科技自立自强章节提出「全面实施人工智能+行动」，以 AI 引领科研范式变革，强化算力、算法、数据高效供给，并把 AI 与产业发展深度结合，推动实体经济与数字经济深度融合、抢占产业应用制高点。
detail.direction_en: Within the science-self-reliance chapter, the proposal calls to 'fully implement the AI+ action', using AI to transform research paradigms, strengthening efficient supply of compute/algorithms/data, and binding AI to industrial development to deepen real-digital economy integration and seize the high ground of industrial application.

initiatives.zh: 全面实施「人工智能+」行动，全方位赋能千行百业
initiatives.en: Fully implement the 'AI+' action, empowering all industries across the board

initiatives.zh: 统筹推进算力设施建设、模型算法发展和高质量数据资源供给
initiatives.en: Coordinate compute-infrastructure build-out, model/algorithm development and high-quality data supply

initiatives.zh: 以人工智能引领科研范式变革，突破基础理论和核心技术
initiatives.en: Use AI to drive research-paradigm change; break through foundational theory and core technologies

initiatives.zh: 促进实体经济和数字经济深度融合，实施工业互联网创新发展工程
initiatives.en: Deepen real-digital economy integration; implement the Industrial Internet innovation-development program

detail.focus_zh: AI+制造、工业互联网、算力/算法/数据供给、千行百业应用
detail.focus_en: AI+manufacturing, industrial internet, compute/algorithm/data supply, cross-industry applications
detail.implications_zh: AI+ 全面落地为工业软件打开「智能化重构」窗口：CAE 生成式优化、EDA 布局布线 AI、MES/工业互联网平台嵌入大模型、数据要素喂养训练成为主线；强调算力/数据供给与实数融合，意味着工业软件须与工业互联网平台、行业大模型耦合，单点工具向 AI 原生平台演进。
detail.implications_en: Full AI+ rollout opens an 'intelligent re-architecture' window for industrial software: generative CAE optimization, AI place-and-route in EDA, LLMs embedded in MES/industrial-internet platforms, and data elements feeding training become the mainline; the emphasis on compute/data supply and real-digital fusion pushes tools to couple with industrial-internet platforms and sector models, evolving from point tools to AI-native platforms.

policies.title_en: CPC Central Committee Proposal on the 15th Five-Year Plan (2026–2030)
policies.summary_zh: 二十届四中全会审议通过的建议全文，定调十五五制造强国、数字中国与科技自立自强方向
policies.summary_en: 4th Plenum-adopted recommendation setting 15th FYP direction for manufacturing power, Digital China, and tech self-reliance
policies.metric_zh: 制造业合理比重
policies.metric_en: Reasonable share of manufacturing in the economy
policies.actual_note_zh: 建议正文表述为「保持制造业合理比重」「加快建设制造强国」，未设可核对的具体百分比；量化指标留待国务院印发的规划纲要及部委专项规划
policies.actual_note_en: Recommendation text calls to keep a reasonable manufacturing share; no verifiable % KPI in the proposal itself—numbers expected in the State Council outline and ministry sector plans

detail.direction_zh: 十五五建议把着力点放在实体经济与现代化产业体系上，明确「保持制造业合理比重」，并在科技自立自强章节首次把「基础软件」与集成电路、工业母机、高端仪器并列为需取得决定性突破的关键核心技术。方向是以自主可控的底层技术支撑制造强国与数字中国。
detail.direction_en: The 15th FYP proposal anchors development on the real economy and a modern industrial system, mandates 'keeping manufacturing at a reasonable share', and for the first time lists 'basic/foundational software' alongside ICs, machine tools and high-end instruments among the key core technologies that must achieve decisive breakthroughs. The thrust is self-controllable underlying technology underpinning a manufacturing power and Digital China.

initiatives.zh: 全链条推动集成电路、工业母机、高端仪器、基础软件、先进材料、生物制造等重点领域关键核心技术攻关取得决定性突破
initiatives.en: Pursue decisive breakthroughs in key core technologies across ICs, machine tools, high-end instruments, basic software, advanced materials and biomanufacturing along the full chain

initiatives.zh: 加快建设制造强国、质量强国、网络强国，保持制造业合理比重
initiatives.en: Accelerate building a manufacturing/quality/cyber power and keep manufacturing at a reasonable share of the economy

initiatives.zh: 促进实体经济和数字经济深度融合，实施工业互联网创新发展工程
initiatives.en: Deepen integration of the real and digital economies; implement the Industrial Internet innovation-development program

initiatives.zh: 深入推进数字中国建设，全面增强自主创新能力
initiatives.en: Deepen Digital China construction and comprehensively strengthen indigenous innovation capacity

detail.focus_zh: 基础软件、集成电路、工业母机、工业互联网、现代化产业体系
detail.focus_en: Basic software, ICs, machine tools, industrial internet, modern industrial system
detail.implications_zh: 工业软件（CAD/CAE/EDA/PLM 等）作为「基础软件」被写入国家级关键核心技术攻关清单，国产替代从行业倡议升格为五年规划的明确任务；与集成电路、工业母机并列意味着 EDA、CAM 等与硬件强耦合的环节将获持续政策与资金支持，信创/自主可控成为长期采购与攻关基准。
detail.implications_en: Industrial software (CAD/CAE/EDA/PLM) is written into the national key-core-technology list as 'basic software', elevating localization from an industry call to an explicit five-year-plan task; its pairing with ICs and machine tools signals sustained policy and funding for hardware-coupled tools (EDA, CAM), making self-controllability a long-horizon procurement and R&D baseline.

detail.direction_zh: 工信部等八部门以《「人工智能+制造」专项行动实施意见》（工信部联科〔2025〕279号，2025-12-25 印发、2026-01-07 公布）首次为人工智能赋能制造业设定 2027 年量化目标，确立「以数据赋模、以模型带数」的总路径，并把「模数共振」行动写入技术底座任务。
detail.direction_en: MIIT and seven other ministries issued the 'AI+Manufacturing' Special Action Implementation Opinion (MIIT Lian Ke [2025] No.279, signed 2025-12-25, released 2026-01-07), setting China's first 2027 quantitative KPIs for AI-enabled manufacturing, anchoring a 'data-empowers-models, models-pull-data' path and embedding the Model-Data Resonance action into the technology-foundation tasks.

initiatives.zh: 推动 3 至 5 个通用大模型在制造业深度应用，形成专业化、综合性行业大模型
initiatives.en: Drive 3-5 general-purpose foundation models into deep manufacturing use; form specialized and comprehensive industry large models

initiatives.zh: 打造 100 个工业领域高质量数据集
initiatives.en: Build 100 high-quality industrial datasets

initiatives.zh: 推广 500 个典型应用场景
initiatives.en: Promote 500 typical application scenarios

initiatives.zh: 选树 1000 家标杆企业
initiatives.en: Select 1,000 benchmark enterprises

initiatives.zh: 培育 2 至 3 家具有全球影响力的生态主导型企业
initiatives.en: Cultivate 2-3 globally influential ecosystem-leading enterprises

detail.focus_zh: 数据-模型双轮：行业大模型、工业高质量数据集、典型场景为可量化抓手，配套「模数共振」行动与算力供给
detail.focus_en: A data-and-model dual engine: industry large models, high-quality industrial datasets and typical scenarios as the quantifiable levers, backed by the Model-Data Resonance action and compute supply
detail.implications_zh: 对工业软件意味着 CAD/CAE/EDA/CAM/PLM/MES 厂商的竞争维度从单点功能转向「行业大模型 + 高质量工业数据集」。研发设计、中试验证、生产制造、营销服务全流程被点名智能化，工业模型与工业数据集从配套资源升级为政策计量单位（100 个数据集 / 500 个场景），数据资产与垂直行业模型能力成为入选 1000 家标杆的硬门槛。
detail.implications_en: For industrial software it shifts CAD/CAE/EDA/CAM/PLM/MES competition from point features to 'industry large model + high-quality industrial dataset.' R&D design, pilot validation, manufacturing and marketing are all named for intelligent upgrade; industrial models and datasets become policy counting units (100 datasets / 500 scenarios), and data-asset + vertical-model capability become the bar for the 1,000 benchmark slots.

policies.title_en: Sector guide: software & IT services transformation
policies.summary_zh: 配套《人工智能赋能制造业重点行业转型指引》对软件业提出智能工具链与垂直智能体路径（无单一数值指标）
policies.summary_en: Companion sector guide sets intelligent tool-chain and vertical-agent paths for software/IT services (no single numeric KPI)
policies.metric_zh: 软件全生命周期智能工具链/垂直智能体培育
policies.metric_en: Full-lifecycle intelligent software toolchain / vertical agents
policies.actual_note_zh: 指引为方向性部署，未设定全国统一的智能体数量或国产化率考核值
policies.actual_note_en: Directional deployment; no nationwide agent-count or localization-rate KPI set
policies.issuer_zh: 工业和信息化部等八部门

detail.direction_zh: 作为《「人工智能+制造」专项行动》附件《人工智能赋能制造业重点行业转型指引》的五大行业之一，「软件和信息技术服务」被给出专属转型路径：打造软件全生命周期智能工具链，并加快基础软件、工业软件及行业应用软件的智能化升级与价值重构。
detail.direction_en: As one of five sectors in the AI-Enabled Manufacturing Key-Industry Transformation Guide (annex to the AI+Manufacturing Special Action), 'software and IT services' gets a dedicated path: build a full-software-lifecycle intelligent toolchain and accelerate the AI upgrade and value reconstruction of basic, industrial and application software.

initiatives.zh: 打造软件全生命周期智能工具链：覆盖需求设计、开发、测试、运维，构建 AI 驱动的开发运维产品
initiatives.en: Full-lifecycle intelligent toolchain across requirements/design, dev, test, ops; AI-driven DevOps products

initiatives.zh: 培育垂直领域低代码平台、智能体开发平台，以模块化 AI 组件封装行业知识
initiatives.en: Cultivate vertical low-code and agent-development platforms using modular AI components to encapsulate domain knowledge

initiatives.zh: 推动人工智能与基础软件、工业软件及制造业行业应用软件融合，实现智能化升级与价值重构
initiatives.en: Fuse AI with basic software, industrial software and manufacturing application software for intelligent upgrade and value reconstruction

detail.focus_zh: 软件开发从「人工主导」向「智能协同」转变；工业软件被明确列为 AI 智能化升级对象
detail.focus_en: Shift software development from 'human-led' to 'intelligent-collaboration'; industrial software explicitly named as an AI-upgrade target
detail.implications_zh: 这是政策文本中罕见地直接点名「工业软件」的条目：工业软件不再只是被赋能的制造工具，其自身也被列为 AI 智能化升级与价值重构的对象，意味着 CAD/CAE/EDA/CAM/PLM 厂商被同时推向两端——既要把 AI 嵌入产品（智能建模、生成式设计、自动化仿真/验证），又可借低代码/智能体平台与全生命周期工具链承接行业知识封装。
detail.implications_en: A rare policy line that names 'industrial software' directly: industrial software is itself made a target of AI upgrade and value reconstruction, not merely an enabling tool. CAD/CAE/EDA/CAM/PLM vendors are pushed two ways at once — embed AI in the product (intelligent modeling, generative design, automated simulation/validation) and leverage low-code/agent platforms plus lifecycle toolchains to encapsulate domain knowledge.

policies.title_en: Secure & reliable eval: HarmonyOS desktop OS Level II
policies.metric_zh: 桌面操作系统安全可靠等级
policies.actual_note_zh: 2026年第1号公告；有效期三年；支撑鸿蒙电脑+国产CAD部署
policies.actual_note_en: 2026 notice #1; valid 3 years; enables Harmony PC + domestic CAD
policies.summary_zh: 信创操作系统与工业软件终端生态节点
policies.summary_en: Xinchuang OS milestone for industrial software endpoints

detail.direction_zh: 《安全可靠测评结果公告（2026年第1号）》中，华为 HarmonyOS（鸿蒙桌面 V1.0）通过 Ⅱ 级安全可靠测评——这是桌面操作系统首次拿到代表「全流程自主」的最高级别；同批统信桌面 V25 为 Ⅰ 级。
detail.direction_en: In CITSEC's 2026 Announcement No.1, Huawei HarmonyOS desktop (V1.0) passed Grade Ⅱ secure-reliable evaluation—the first desktop OS to reach the top 'fully autonomous' tier; UnionTech UOS V25 in the same batch is Grade Ⅰ.

initiatives.zh: Ⅱ 级桌面 OS：HarmonyOS V1.0（华为终端有限公司）
initiatives.en: Grade Ⅱ desktop OS: HarmonyOS V1.0 (Huawei Terminal)

initiatives.zh: Ⅰ 级桌面 OS：统信桌面操作系统 V25（统信软件）
initiatives.en: Grade Ⅰ desktop OS: UnionTech Desktop OS V25 (UnionTech)

initiatives.zh: 依据《安全可靠测评工作指南 V3.0》，有效期 3 年
initiatives.en: Per Secure-Reliable Evaluation Work Guide V3.0; 3-year validity

detail.focus_zh: 桌面 OS 自主等级上探至 Ⅱ 级，与 2025 年 Ⅱ 级 CPU 形成「自主 CPU + 自主 OS」配对
detail.focus_en: Desktop-OS autonomy climbs to Grade Ⅱ, pairing with the 2025 Grade Ⅱ CPUs to form an 'autonomous CPU + autonomous OS' couple
detail.implications_zh: CAD/CAE 桌面应用最终要落在操作系统上。HarmonyOS 达 Ⅱ 级，意味着工业软件 GUI、图形渲染、文件系统调用可建立在一个全自主 OS 之上，闭环了「Ⅱ级CPU→Ⅱ级OS」的桌面底座；但鸿蒙的应用框架（ArkUI/原生 API）与传统 Linux/X11 工业软件生态差异大，CAD 厂商需评估是兼容层运行还是原生重写，移植成本是关键变量。
detail.implications_en: CAD/CAE desktop apps ultimately sit on the OS. HarmonyOS reaching Grade Ⅱ means industrial-software GUIs, graphics rendering and filesystem calls can rest on a fully autonomous OS, closing the 'Ⅱ-grade CPU -> Ⅱ-grade OS' desktop base. But HarmonyOS's app framework (ArkUI/native APIs) diverges sharply from the Linux/X11 ecosystem most industrial software targets—CAD vendors must weigh compatibility-layer execution vs native rewrite, with porting cost the decisive variable.

detail.direction_zh: 作为十五五开局年报告，2026 政府工作报告把「深化拓展人工智能+」「打造5G+工业互联网升级版」「打造智能经济新形态」列为重点，并部署制造业重点产业链高质量发展、工业基础再造、大规模设备更新与中小企业数智化转型，强调 AI 在重点行业的商业化规模化落地。
detail.direction_en: As the opening-year report of the 15th FYP, the 2026 government work report prioritizes 'deepening and expanding AI+', 'building an upgraded 5G+Industrial Internet', and 'a new form of intelligent economy', while deploying high-quality development of key manufacturing chains, industrial-base re-engineering, large-scale equipment renewal and SME digital-intelligent transformation, stressing commercialized at-scale AI in key sectors.

initiatives.zh: 深化拓展「人工智能+」，建设国家人工智能应用中试基地
initiatives.en: Deepen and expand 'AI+'; build national AI-application pilot-test bases

initiatives.zh: 打造「5G+工业互联网」升级版
initiatives.en: Build an upgraded version of '5G+Industrial Internet'

initiatives.zh: 推动重点行业领域人工智能商业化规模化应用，培育智能原生新业态
initiatives.en: Drive commercialized, at-scale AI in key sectors and cultivate intelligent-native new business forms

initiatives.zh: 实施制造业重点产业链高质量发展行动，推进工业基础再造和重大技术装备攻关
initiatives.en: Implement the high-quality-development action for key manufacturing chains; advance industrial-base re-engineering and major-equipment breakthroughs

initiatives.zh: 普惠「上云用数赋智」，支持中小企业数智化转型
initiatives.en: Inclusive 'cloud-data-intelligence' services to support SME digital-intelligent transformation

detail.focus_zh: AI+制造、工业互联网、集成电路、设备更新、中小企业数智化
detail.focus_en: AI+manufacturing, industrial internet, ICs, equipment renewal, SME digitalization
detail.implications_zh: 开局年把规划方向变为可执行预算与抓手：5G+工业互联网升级版与上云用数赋智直接拉动 MES/工业互联网平台、SaaS 化工业软件在中小企业的渗透；大规模设备更新与设备数智化为 DCS/CAM/数采软件创造替换需求；AI 应用中试基地为工业大模型/生成式 CAE 提供落地通道，国产化是隐含采购前提。
detail.implications_en: The opening year turns plan direction into executable budgets and levers: the upgraded 5G+Industrial Internet and inclusive cloud-data-intelligence directly drive MES/industrial-internet-platform and SaaS-ified industrial-software penetration into SMEs; large-scale equipment renewal creates replacement demand for DCS/CAM/data-acquisition software; AI pilot-test bases give industrial LLMs/generative CAE a deployment path, with localization an implicit procurement premise.

policies.title_en: 2026 Model-Data Resonance action (AI+Manufacturing follow-through)

detail.direction_zh: 工业和信息化部办公厅、国家数据局综合司联合印发《关于联合实施2026年「模数共振」行动的通知》（工信厅联科函〔2026〕193号，2026-04-24），落地《「人工智能+制造」专项行动》技术底座任务，推动「数据-模型-场景应用」良性互促、同频共振，年底前基本形成该闭环。
detail.direction_en: MIIT General Office and the National Data Bureau Comprehensive Department jointly issued the 2026 Model-Data Resonance Action notice (MIIT Ting Lian Ke Han [2026] No.193, 2026-04-24), operationalizing the AI+Manufacturing technology foundation by driving a virtuous 'data-model-scenario' resonance loop, to be basically formed by end-2026.

initiatives.zh: 构建行业通识数据集、打造行业模型（每行业不少于5个通识数据集、不少于1个行业模型）
initiatives.en: Build industry-general datasets and industry models (>=5 general datasets and >=1 industry model per sector)

initiatives.zh: 梳理高价值场景、构建行业专识数据集、打造特色智能体（每行业不少于30个高价值场景）
initiatives.en: Curate high-value scenarios, build sector-specialized datasets and bespoke agents (>=30 high-value scenarios per sector)

initiatives.zh: 建立评测数据集，形成「评测诊断-数据集优化-模型能力提升」循环
initiatives.en: Build evaluation datasets, forming an 'eval-diagnose / dataset-optimize / model-improve' loop

initiatives.zh: 创建「模数共振」空间（每省级地区不少于3个），探索跨主体数据可信贯通与模型协同训练
initiatives.en: Create Model-Data Resonance spaces (>=3 per provincial region) for trusted cross-party data flow and joint model training

initiatives.zh: 打造「模数共振」创新联合体、构建行业级全栈方案（每行业不少于1个）
initiatives.en: Form Resonance innovation consortia and full-stack sector solutions (>=1 per sector)

detail.focus_zh: 覆盖钢铁、汽车、医疗装备、航空航天、电子元器件、软件等20个重点行业；省级方案 2026-05-30 前提交，中期总结 2026-08-30，最终总结 2026-11-30
detail.focus_en: Covers 20 priority sectors including steel, autos, medical equipment, aerospace, electronic components and software; provincial plans due 2026-05-30, mid-term review 2026-08-30, final summary 2026-11-30
detail.implications_zh: 这是工业软件最直接的政策抓手：把工业数据集（通识/专识/评测三类）、工业行业模型、特色智能体定义为可申报、可计量的交付物，并以省为单位下达数量配额。「模数共振」空间本质是受信工业数据空间 + 协同训练基础设施，触及 PLM/MES 的数据治理与工业互联网平台；CAE/EDA 等仿真工具的高价值场景与专识数据集成为入选创新联合体的筹码。
detail.implications_en: This is the most direct policy hook for industrial software: it defines industrial datasets (general/specialized/evaluation), industry models and bespoke agents as declarable, countable deliverables with per-province quotas. The Resonance 'space' is effectively a trusted industrial data space plus joint-training infra, touching PLM/MES data governance and IIoT platforms; CAE/EDA simulation tools' high-value scenarios and specialized datasets become entry tickets to the innovation consortia.

detail.direction_zh: 《安全可靠测评结果公告（2026年第2号）》首次将 AI 训练/推理芯片纳入安全可靠测评，公布首批 9 款国产 AI 芯片目录，均为 Ⅰ 级——把信创底座从 CPU/OS 扩展到「智能算力」维度。
detail.direction_en: CITSEC's 2026 Announcement No.2 brings AI training/inference chips into secure-reliable evaluation for the first time, publishing an initial catalog of 9 domestic AI chips, all Grade Ⅰ—extending the secure-reliable base from CPU/OS into the 'intelligent compute' dimension.

initiatives.zh: 华为昇腾 310、昇腾 910；阿里平头哥 真武 M530、真武 M890
initiatives.en: Huawei Ascend 310, Ascend 910; Alibaba T-Head Zhenwu M530, Zhenwu M890

initiatives.en: Biren BR166, Hygon DCU-3G, Enflame KCC-V100X, MetaX MXC600, Moore Threads PH100

initiatives.zh: 全部 Ⅰ 级（目前 AI 芯片暂无 Ⅱ 级），有效期 3 年
initiatives.en: All Grade Ⅰ (no Grade Ⅱ AI chip yet); 3-year validity

detail.focus_zh: 覆盖训练与推理两类负载、9 家主流厂商，建立国产 AI 加速器的「安全可靠」准入目录
detail.focus_en: Covers both training and inference workloads across 9 leading vendors, establishing a secure-reliable admission catalog for domestic AI accelerators
detail.implications_zh: AI+CAE（代理模型、拓扑优化、生成式设计）与 AI+制造日益依赖大规模加速算力。国产 AI 芯片首批入目录，意味着工业软件的 AI 推理/训练环节也能落在自主硬件上，补齐了 CPU/OS 之外的第三块底座；但全部仅 Ⅰ 级（含海外代工依赖），且 CUDA→国产软件栈（CANN/各家 SDK）的迁移与算子覆盖仍是工业级 AI 工作负载落地的主要摩擦点。
detail.implications_en: AI+CAE (surrogate models, topology optimization, generative design) and AI-driven manufacturing increasingly depend on large-scale accelerators. Domestic AI chips entering the catalog mean industrial software's AI inference/training can also run on autonomous hardware, completing the third base layer beyond CPU/OS. But all are only Grade Ⅰ (overseas-foundry dependence remains), and the CUDA->domestic-stack (CANN/per-vendor SDK) migration plus operator coverage stay the main friction for production-grade industrial AI workloads.
